en.t: It was only that kind of dream.

units.source_text: 而且都是梦见白天发生的事情。

en.t: And they were all dreams about things that had happened during the day.

units.source_text: 千重子把手伸进池水里，轻轻拨动了一下，鲤鱼就这样迅速聚拢过来了。

en.t: When Chieko put her hand into the pond water and stirred it gently, the carp quickly gathered around just like that.

units.source_text: 她有点愕然，对鲤鱼群生出一股无可名状的爱怜之情。

en.t: She was a little astonished, and felt an indescribable tenderness toward the school of carp.
